title: I built a typing game — would love your feedback
author: U_RATHORE
selftext:
Hey everyone! I’ve been working on a small typing game called Typing Attack and I’d love to get some honest feedback from the community.

The idea is simple: type as fast and accurately as you can to defeat the incoming attacks. I wanted to make typing practice feel a little more like a game rather than a traditional typing test.

I’m especially looking for feedback on:

\- UI/UX — Is the interface clean and easy to understand?

\- Gameplay — Does the game actually feel fun and engaging?

\- Difficulty — Does the difficulty progression feel balanced?

\- Design — What would you improve visually?

\- Features — What would make you want to play it again?

\- Bugs or anything that feels confusing

I’m still actively improving it, so honest criticism is much more useful than just saying it looks good.

If you have a minute, give it a try and let me know what you think.

Any feedback is genuinely appreciated!
